name: Tam
source:
Hired by the galactic express to promote the railroad project. Though she doesn't actually have to do anything. Rumored to have offed her first husband. Popular opinion is that she was hired at brother in laws behest, for the sole reason of hitting on her. 
[From [url=https://teamotomegamejam.itch.io/the-algernon-affair]itch.io[/url]]
